name: Kashiwara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kashiwara city emblem in red: an outlined ring enclosing a three-armed device.
history: Municipal flag of Kashiwara, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1958.

features.role: Kashiwara city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a three-armed device
